item.description:
A code-quality and modernization pass — same feature surface, smoother under load. No new user-visible features.

  • Smoother list updates on heavy histories. ConversationStore migrated to the macOS 14 @Observable framework. Per-property tracking replaces the legacy ObservableObject pattern that invalidated every observer in the conversation list on every property write. Visible payoff is frames not stuttering when a single piece of state changes (e.g. the open-tab set) while the rest of the list is unchanged.
  • Faster window appearance on cold launch. The JSONL backfill, the per-tick ~/.claude/sessions/ scan, and the init-time month-discovery walk now run off the main actor. The window appears immediately with the cached snapshot; live data layers in as it arrives.
  • Live ingestion correctness regression test. Pinned a subtle URL.path() trailing-slash mismatch in the JSONL watcher that, under modern URL construction (URL.homeDirectory.appending(path: …)), would silently classify every JSONL as a symlink-escape and discover zero files — freezing the conversation list on the cached snapshot from the previous launch. Caught in development, not in shipped binaries.
  • Under the hood: GCD replaced with Swift concurrency where idiomatic. Foundation API call sites swept for modern equivalents (URL(filePath:), Date.now, Duration.formatted(.time) for cache TTL, FormatStyle for cost rendering, Swift Regex for model-name normalization). PitsApp.swift split into one-type-per-file. Force-unwrap on the pricing-cache URL replaced with a sentinel-valid fallback. Forward-looking review process documented in CLAUDE.md (audit-locked false positives + the URL trailing-slash gotcha). 243 tests on macos-26.
